scope: Targeted future-interpretation API/UI, temporal, sequence, conditional and ordinary-phrase checks. Full regression baseline remains 2cc85e7; this is not a fresh full-suite run.

results.output: Future interpretation: 9 state/negation/bound-compound cases require explicit selection, then preserve tomorrow and runtime independently with reference/MIDI parity. UI does not compose before selection and rejects stale input; unresolved clause groups produce no partial translation.

Temporal music: before/at/after speech time remain distinct, lexical state is unchanged, Ruby/browser output agrees, and unsounded anchor details fail.
Calendar-day music: previous/current/next calendar days are distinct from speech-time relations, with Ruby/browser parity and strict anchor checks.
Explicit sequences: whole-IR Ruby parity, exact MIDI parity, action order, clause boundary and unsupported-clause rejection pass.

Conditional commands: eight full renderer/MIDI parity cases, local definite-reference identity, explicit-reference paraphrase equivalence, command/assertion contrast, negation scope and independent runtime endings.
